انتحلتما (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَلْتُمَا (intaḥaltumā) /in.ta.ħal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اُنْتُحِلْتُمَا (untuḥiltumā) /un.tu.ħil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
